provenance: written by the maintainers for v1.2.0

evals.prompt: ChatGPT wrote my references. Check that every entry in references.bib actually exists.
evals.expected_output: Runs verify_citations.py, reports verified, mismatch, not-found and retracted entries, and never keeps unverifiable refs silently

evals.prompt: One of my citations might have been retracted. How do I check all 60?
evals.expected_output: Runs verify_citations.py, which flags retracted entries from Crossref Retraction Watch notices and OpenAlex; does not cite retracted work as support

evals.prompt: The DOI in my bib resolves, but I'm not sure it is the right paper.
evals.expected_output: Explains that a resolving DOI proves nothing; compares title, first author and year with the record and reports mismatch

evals.prompt: I cite a Zenodo dataset and a GitHub release DOI. The checker says doi-not-found.
evals.expected_output: Uses the DataCite resolution built into the script; dataset and software DOIs verify instead of failing

evals.prompt: Mark every reference you can't verify directly in the .bib so I can see them.
evals.expected_output: Runs verify_citations.py --annotate, which inserts % UNVERIFIED comments above flagged entries without touching entry bodies

evals.prompt: Add the missing DOIs to my references.
evals.expected_output: Applies only found-add-doi suggestions, leaves mismatch and not-found entries for the user to confirm

evals.prompt: Half my entries show 'uncertain' and the message says OpenAlex could not be queried.
evals.expected_output: Explains the rate limit or outage, re-runs later with CROSSREF_MAILTO set, and does not treat uncertain as fabricated

evals.prompt: Camera-ready is tomorrow. Make sure no reference in the final bib is fake or corrupted.
evals.expected_output: Runs verify_citations.py on the final bib, fixes mechanical issues, escalates mismatches and not-found entries, and checks the cited claim as well

evals.prompt: Check whether this one DOI is real: 10.1126/science.aaa8415
evals.expected_output: Runs verify_citations.py --doi and reports the resolved title, year and first author

evals.prompt: My bib has conference papers without DOIs and the reference checker reports them as missing. What should I do?
evals.expected_output: Explains the arXiv fallback, citing proceedings with a url, and optionally eprint

evals.prompt: Clean up capitalization and duplicate keys in my .bib.
evals.expected_output: Skill not used; bibtex-hygiene fits better

evals.prompt: Convert my EndNote library to BibTeX.
evals.expected_output: Skill not used; reference-manager-interop fits better

evals.prompt: Find five good papers to cite for this claim.
evals.expected_output: Skill not used; literature-review or paper-lookup fits better
